hero.heading: Run the business side, so you can get back to the job side.
hero.subheading: Ai4Trade replaces the spreadsheet, the paper EICR pad, and the group chat with your office — one subscription per business, free for every customer who books through you.

items.label: JOB-01
items.title: One board for every job
items.description: Track enquiries, quotes, scheduled work, and completed jobs across your whole team — no spreadsheets, no missed callbacks.

items.label: QUO-02
items.title: Automated quoting rules
items.description: Set pricing by job type and postcode once. Every new enquiry gets a quote back in minutes, not after you've finished today's jobs.

items.label: CER-03
items.title: EICR certificates, start to finish
items.description: Run the inspection, log observation codes, and issue a signed certificate — all inside the same job record.

items.label: FLR-04
items.title: Floorplans from the site visit
items.description: Sketch circuits on site on a tablet, and turn them into a floorplan the whole team can reference on the next visit.

items.label: TEA-05
items.title: Team roles and permissions
items.description: Control what each engineer, office admin, or subcontractor can see and edit as your team grows past two people.

items.label: SUB-06
items.title: One subscription, unlimited free customers
items.description: You pay one subscription. Every homeowner who books through your portal uses it for free — always.

sections.heading: Your customers book through a page with your name on it
sections.text: Every subscribing business gets its own web address — shareable on invoices, your van, or your own website.
sections.sideText: Homeowners who book through your portal register for free — they're your customers, not ours. You never see another business's jobs, and no one sees yours.

sections.heading: Watch a job go from enquiry to signed certificate

seo.title: Ai4Trade for electrical businesses
seo.description: Job management, quoting, EICR certification, and a free branded customer portal — for electrical businesses of any size.
